authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Turner addendum 14295 to indradhanus explicitly gives Shina bizon rainbow crossed with vidhra. The selected neighbouring Indus Kohistani/Chilisso bizon/bizon/bizvan forms closely match this published crossed family. Preserve vowel/sibilant differences and the crossing qualification; inheritance versus cross-IA transmission remains unresolved, and no direct Shina donor is asserted. Exact response: bīžon.
